charged_cost: Naive modular transforms and repeated root/power computation cost O(Q*K+Q*M) plus O(Q^2) direct references per test vector; this is a certificate, not the fast floating executor or unbounded-N arithmetic model.
findings_and_limits: Archived Q=56 and119 check every basis vector and six dense vectors. Q=136 and238 check only first24 basis vectors plus six dense vectors; status exact means exact modular arithmetic on these tests, not exhaustive all-input verification at those latter sizes.
global_boundary: Static source coverage is not theorem acceptance, successful current execution, provenance proof of a historical run, full dependency closure, or completion of all research checks.
